criteria.description: Continuity kind constants are present at the assigned values and do not collide with existing hot-file kind families.
Continuity definition and command events serialize required indexed tags and decode into validated domain or wire payloads.
Heartbeat observations carry worker, sequence, interval, and expiration tags and decode deterministically without sleep-based waiting.

The control-plane reactor subscribes to continuity definition and command kinds using the existing author-scoped control-plane filter while heartbeat observations use a kind-scoped, non-author-scoped filter for worker-originated events.
